copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为 AI 助手制定明确的规则与工作流程
copy.tagline_en: Write clear, actionable guidelines for AI assistants

howto.what: 当 Claude 编写技能、AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 等供 agent 阅读的文档时,会遵循文中原则:用上下文指针控制加载,区分步骤与参考,设定可检查的完成标准,并用引领导词精简表达。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或编辑技能、修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 时,该技能会触发并作为写作参考。

say.text: 帮我写一个技能,描述要能准确触发。
say.note: Claude 会参考该文编写技能描述。

say.text: 重构 AGENTS.md,把参考信息用指针隐藏起来。
say.note: 它会运用信息层级和渐进披露。

say.text: 编辑 CLAUDE.md,避免重复并精简。
say.note: 它会检查重复和冗余,进行修剪。

howto.what_en: When writing documents for agents, including skills, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md, Claude follows these principles: context pointers, information hierarchy, clear completion criteria, and leading words.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating or editing a skill, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

say_en.text: Write a skill with a description that triggers properly.
say_en.note: Claude applies the reference to skill writing.

say_en.text: Refactor AGENTS.md to move reference behind pointers.
say_en.note: It uses information hierarchy and disclosure.

say_en.text: Edit CLAUDE.md to remove duplication and trim.
say_en.note: It prunes stale and no-op lines.
